title: remove_background arguments
description: Remove an image background with BiRefNet while preserving the original foreground. Returns a transparent PNG cutout by default, or a soft foreground mask. Uses the original source image without generative repainting; takes no prompt.

sourceImageIndex.description: Original source image: negative indices select uploads (-1 is the first), non-negative indices select generated images. Omit to use the latest image.

source_image_url.description: REST alternative to sourceImageIndex: retrievable source image URL.

applyMask.description: True (default) returns a transparent cutout; false returns the soft mask.
